gold: Succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient paraganglioma of the prostate with multiple and recurrent paragangliomas
e7_s4_rationale: The patient has a SDHB gene variant (c.338G>A, p.C113Y) and a history of paraganglioma (10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl in 1984) and subsequent development of a nodule in the left adrenal bed, which is consistent with a diagnosis of SDHB-related paraganglioma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Pheochromocytoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: While the patient has elevated urinary normetanephrine, the presence of a SDHB gene variant and the location of the tumors (organ of Zukerkandl and left adrenal bed) are more consistent with paraganglioma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Paraganglioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: This is a plausible diagnosis, but the presence of a SDHB gene variant makes SDHB-related paraganglioma a more specific and accurate diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Familial paraganglioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: There is limited access to family history, making it difficult to confirm a familial component.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Prostatic paraganglioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: While the patient has a prostatic lesion, the primary diagnosis is more likely related to the SDHB gene variant and the history of paraganglioma, rather than a primary prostatic paraganglioma.
